intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Last night, you were a software engineer reading rejection email number forty-one.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: It began with *Unfortunately*. They always begin with *Unfortunately*.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I’m starting to think the job market was balanced by a game designer who hates me personally.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Then the world folded like a badly tested dropdown, and you fell out of it into a kingdom with more castles than entry-level openings.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The first thing you see is a royal notice nailed to a wall: *THE COURTSHIP SEASON IS OPEN. TWENTY-EIGHT DAYS. ONE PRINCESS. GENUINE AFFECTION ONLY. NO EXTENSIONS.*

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I was hoping for a recruiter, but sure.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Underneath, in smaller letters: *Improve yourself. Learn her weekly schedule. Remember that the princess is allowed to say no.*

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Finally. An application process with clear requirements.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Day one begins. Somewhere in this kingdom, a princess is about to have a very unusual month.
